base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl python3.11-venv python3-pip
setup_runtime_commands: pip install transformers==4.31.0 sentencepiece tokenizers==0.13.3 accelerate==0.21.0 --retries 5 --timeout 60
runtime_smoke_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/python/llm/src'); import bigdl.llm; print('BigDL-LLM import successful')"

prepare_commands: pip install transformers==4.31.0 sentencepiece tokenizers==0.13.3 accelerate==0.21.0 lm_eval pytest
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: No additional test-only dependencies needed; pytest is installed in base environment
runtime_profile.notes: CPU-only torch variant used to reduce download size from >2.5GB to ~200MB. This is essential for network-constrained environments with 500-900 kB/s bandwidth. BigDL-LLM package accessible via .pth file. Native binary dependencies not included due to network restrictions, but Python modules are importable for testing the kwargs handling logic fix.

notes: NETWORK-OPTIMIZED BUILD: Git and curl provided by base python:3.11-slim-bookworm image. STRATEGY: CPU-only torch from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu reduces download from >2.5GB CUDA variant to ~200MB - critical for 500-900 kB/s bandwidth. The test (test_optimize_model.py) tests that optimize_model and use_cache flags are correctly retrieved from bigdl_llm_kwargs - this kwargs handling logic can be verified without requiring actual GPU inference. BigDL-LLM package installed via .pth file since native binaries require sourceforge downloads.
